precedence: Evidence failure/identity/coverage first; remaining outcomes are stage-local and can coexist across slices/requests, not necessarily an additive workload-level partition.

outcomes.condition: accepted_ro=0 with accepted demand/admission funnel coverage
outcomes.supported_statement: No realized RO transactions in this input/profile; separate resident hits, deferred/native and actual miss/admit gates.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: No Tag-abundance, detach correctness or performance conclusion.

outcomes.condition: accepted_ro>0; raw_pressure=0; exact covered frontend denominator complete
outcomes.supported_statement: No all-reserved set pressure at these covered observations.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Not all traffic/cycles; no global Tag sufficiency claim; skipped upstream/early paths remain scope-limited.

outcomes.condition: raw_pressure>0; same-set liveRO=0 with full local scan
outcomes.supported_statement: Observed pressure lacks simultaneous local live RO victims.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Another-set RO not evidence for local eligibility; no counterfactual speedup.

outcomes.supported_statement: Report exclusive attached/reuse_seen/required-not-ready priority bins plus nonexclusive predicate masks. Sticky reuse persists after merged waiter retires.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Dominant first-reason count depends precedence and exposure; not independent causal contribution or all-ready lower completion.

outcomes.condition: shadow_eligible>0; production relief test not evaluated
outcomes.supported_statement: Native/nonRO/feature/early path did not consult relief at observed point; exact class/path evidence.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Not no-eligible or producer bug, not globally unreachable. Preserve original path.

outcomes.supported_statement: Report preview intermediate status and first admission blocker/coverage; snapshots and commit have different domains.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Exposure totals alone do not show a missed selection or equality with relieve counts.

outcomes.condition: actual detach_success>0; triggering same call refused later
outcomes.supported_statement: Observed Tag release can precede WAD/landing/bank/MissQ/other denial; report immediate acceptance separately.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Do not equate detach with admitted trigger, saved program cycles or eventual retry success.

outcomes.condition: detach_success>0; existing counter reconciles; generation/response/retirement closure accepted by E
outcomes.supported_statement: Application-level successful Tag-detach evidence within exact model/input/source.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Not isolated T/M speedup, positive performance or new invariant proof from D counters.

outcomes.condition: detach_success=0; relevant coverage full; E invariants/terminal accepted
outcomes.supported_statement: Publish exact pressure/eligibility/path distribution and scope; scientifically valid negative.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: Do not weaken sticky reuse/ready guard or reshape input to manufacture activation.

outcomes.condition: selection/handshake mismatch, unclosed counts, overflow, identity gap, incomplete run
outcomes.supported_statement: Retain failure or affected UNKNOWN classification from E; provide bounded witness and owner gap.
outcomes.forbidden_inference: No failed/mid-run cycles as full performance; no silent missing0 or requalification by D.

source_vs_data: Audit findings are source-derived; numerical observations require E accepted new diagnostic record; causes remain conditional hypotheses absent event-matched evidence.
